description: The NEGATIVE half of issue #830: parenthesizing a bare `value` must not smuggle the keyword in as a `parenthesized-call` callee (`spec/grammar.md:215`). The `(` path reaches the Heritage `value-of-reader` (:217) only when `of` directly follows `value`; otherwise `value` is rejected in expression position exactly as in any other (#853, #885), and a single `ol-bad-token` names the offending word. This shape had NO conformance coverage before this fixture — `core-language/diagnostics/reserved-word-in-value-position` asserts the same code for the UNparenthesized position only, proven by it staying green under the very mutation (making `isCalleeName` accept `value`) that reopens #830. Exactly ONE diagnostic is correct here: `( value )` is BALANCED, so `ol-unmatched-paren` must not appear — `spec/error-model.md` reserves it for a delimiter with no partner. The parser previously emitted it twice around this error because the group bailed without consuming its `)`; the review of #830 fixed that recovery in `parseParenthesized`, and this fixture is what holds it. Heritage + Data are active so the rejection is asserted under the same profile set as the positive twin `heritage-value-of-key-reader-in-parentheses`, where the reader IS available (`spec/conformance.md:305`).
